image_description: A still life composition featuring five green figs arranged on and around a white ceramic plate against a solid blue background. Three figs are on the plate, and two are in the foreground. The figs exhibit a characteristic pear-like shape with smooth green skin.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Pear-shaped fruit with soft, thin skin in green, purple, or brownish coloration.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The objects are clearly pear-shaped and green, matching the description of unripe or specific green varieties of figs.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Smooth to slightly wrinkled texture with matte finish.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The skin appears smooth with a subtle matte-to-satin sheen, consistent with fresh fig skin.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Elongated pear shape with tapered form from broad base to narrow stem end.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: All visible fruits display the correct tapering geometry from the bulbous bottom to the neck.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Small ostiole (eye) at bottom of fruit.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The bottom (base) of the figs is either resting on the plate/surface or angled away from the camera; the ostiole is not visible.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Narrow stem end contrasting with broad rounded base.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The contrast between the thick body and the thin neck/stem area is clearly visible on all subjects.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Thin, easily bruised skin covering soft interior.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: This is a material property that cannot be visually verified without physical interaction or damage to the fruit.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Cut cross-section reveals hollow interior filled with numerous tiny seeds.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: None of the figs are cut open; the interior is completely occluded.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Sweet, pink to amber-colored fleshy pulp surrounding seeds.

checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: Texture of the interior pulp cannot be seen.

artifact_observations.location: Right side of the white plate
artifact_observations.reasoning: The rim of the plate dissolves into the blue background on the right side. The geometric structure of the plate fails to maintain a continuous elliptical curve, appearing to melt or fade out rather than ending at a hard edge.

artifact_observations.location: Foreground figs and plate contact points
artifact_observations.reasoning: The contact shadows between the foreground figs and the surface are weak and inconsistent. The fig on the bottom right seems to float slightly above the surface due to lack of proper occlusion shadow.

The skin texture is overly uniform and plastic-like, lacking the minute pores, lenticels, or natural micro-imperfections typical of real fig skin. It resembles rendered 3D models more than organic matter.
